## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

Commodity-driven market: USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND vs CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND; GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION reflecting profit taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ABOVE TREND align on higher volatility. Divergence: TLT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION and multiple 1W/1M mismatches (GLD, ARKK, TLT) represent MINOR divergence — note but don’t overweight.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor exposure to energy/commodity ETFs (XLE, USO, BNO) showing strength and reduce exposure to small-cap and cyclicals underperforming (IWM, XME) while monitoring volatility via VXX and duration via TLT.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND — watch oil momentum.  
BEARISH: XME (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND — watch industrials/metal weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND on supply-risk headlines.  
BEARISH: CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -4.09%) BELOW TREND — watch reflation fade.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~30 (elevated volatility alert); HYG/LQD ~0.72 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF 2.71 (growth vs value pivot); TLT 1M trend reversal (monitor CORRECTION dynamics).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
